$description: Not in Figma: Figma has no motion variables yet. Written by hand (DTCG); npm run tokens:pull never touches this file, npm run tokens:build merges it with the Figma tokens into src/tokens.css. Values from the prototype's clusters (augur-design.html). Each duration's com.govocal.reducedMotion is what it becomes under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

fast.$description: A change in place: hover, press and focus colours, fades, a chevron turning, a tooltip or menu appearing, a dialog leaving.

medium.$description: A short move or an entrance: an indicator or knob sliding, a tick drawing, a dialog or coachmark coming in.

slow.$description: A change of size or a long move: a panel opening, a tab panel resizing, a sheet or toast sliding, a bar filling.

loop.$description: One cycle of a repeating status: a skeleton pulsing, an indeterminate bar sweeping. Not shortened under reduced motion (a 1 ms loop flickers): the component stops it.

standard.$description: In place: colours, fades, a chevron turning, a press; and one transition that plays both ways (a popover in and out). CSS's ease, the prototype's default.

enter.$description: Something arriving: quick start, soft landing (a dialog, toast or card coming in).

exit.$description: Something leaving: soft start, quick finish (a dialog or toast going away). CSS's ease-in.

move.$description: Something travelling or resizing on screen: an indicator or knob sliding, a panel opening, a bar filling; and loops.
